描述_EN: a saddle cloth decorated with clouds and flowers covers the elephant's back, numerous jewels and pendants adorn his harness and trappings, and his feet rest on lotus pedestals. a platform on the elephant's head supports three figures representing three personifications of the buddha, while a group of celestial musicians sits on one of the elephant's six tusks. samantabhadra wears the princely robes of a bodhisattva and a highly ornamented crown bearing a flaming pearl, his attribute. he holds a gilded lotus stem topped with a blue lotus blossom. the bodhisattva samantabhadra, who symbolises the infinite wisdom of the buddha, sits upon an elephant. because at some point in its life the scroll has been cut down, the position of samantabhadra now appears off-centre, and his halo is incomplete. executed in water-based colours and gold on silk, the painting is now mounted on paper, and attached to narrow silk border. the painting originally formed part of a triptych, with sakyamuni buddha in the centre, manjusri (bodhisattva of universal wisdom) seated on a lion on the left, and samantabhadra on the right. a devotional image of great power, this painting of samantabhadra is a remarkable survival from mediaeval korea or china.
描述_ZN: 大象的背上有一块饰有云彩和花朵的马鞍布，无数的珠宝和挂件装饰着他的马具和装备，他的脚放在莲花座上。 大象头上的平台支撑着三个代表佛祖的人物，而一群天人乐师则坐在大象的六根牙上。 萨摩耶身穿菩萨的王子袍，头戴高度装饰的王冠，上面有一颗燃烧的珍珠，这是他的特征。 他手持镀金的莲花茎，上面有一朵蓝色的莲花。 象征着佛陀无限智慧的萨满陀罗菩萨坐在大象身上。 因为在生命中的某个时刻，卷轴被砍掉了，所以现在萨满菩萨的位置出现了偏差，他的光环也不完整。 在丝绸上用水彩和金线执行，这幅画现在被装在纸上，并附在狭窄的丝绸边上。 这幅画原本是三联画的一部分，中间是释迦牟尼佛，左边是坐在狮子上的文殊菩萨（普贤菩萨），右边是三藏菩萨。 这幅萨满陀罗的画是中世纪韩国或中国的杰出作品，是一幅具有巨大力量的虔诚图像。
